description: This file defines the ConnectionBasedRabbitConnectionFactoryFactory class, which implements a factory for creating RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory instances based on a Connection object. It includes configuration for SSL, timeouts, recovery, and other connection parameters, along with singleton access.

classes.name: ConnectionBasedRabbitConnectionFactoryFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class to create configured RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory instances based on a Connection object.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: createConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory with configurations determined by the given Connection, ExceptionHandler, and ConnectionLogger.

methods.name: configureConnectionFactory
methods.description: Applies specific configuration parameters from a map to the ConnectionFactory.
